body.purpose: All running text, labels and form fields.

label.purpose: Navigation titles, badges, metadata and table headers.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Background transitions on buttons and segmented options; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a form or panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 16px; border: 1px solid #0f6cbd; border-radius: 4px; background: #0f6cbd; color: #fff; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #115ea3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005a9e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions: refresh, add scene, freeze version.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 16px; border: 1px solid #0f6cbd; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #0f6cbd; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e5effa; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005a9e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Choose one of a few short options (aspect ratio, takes).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; border: 1px solid #8a8886; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg span { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 8px; background: #fff; } .ds-seg span.on { background: #e5effa; color: #0c3b5e; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #0f6cbd; }

components.name: Side Navigation Item
components.description: Side-rail view switch; the selected item is tinted.
components.html: Create videoVision datasets
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 200px; padding: 12px; background: #fafafa; border-right: 1px solid #d1d1d1; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; color: #424242; } .ds-nav-item.on { background: #e5effa; color: #0c3b5e; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Run or job state, always with a text label.
components.html: Completed Queued Failed
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 4px; font: 12px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-ok { background: #edf7ed; border-color: #afcfae; color: #245323; } .ds-badge-warn { background: #fff5df; border-color: #dbc594; color: #654800; } .ds-badge-bad { background: #fdf3f4; border-color: #dfb0b4; color: #8f1e24; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Connection and readiness message above the workspace.
components.html: Local mode: ComfyUI is connected. Videos are stored in Azurite/studio; no Azure ML or cloud compute is used.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid #b9d8f2; border-radius: 4px; background: #eef5fc; color: #20415c; font: 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Frame Filmstrip
components.description: Frames of a video to label; reviewed frames get a green border, the selected one an accent outline.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-strip button { width: 72px; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid #d1d1d1; background: #fff; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-strip button.done { border-color: #107c10; } .ds-strip button.sel { outline: 2px solid #0f6cbd; }

components.name: Job Progress
components.description: Live stage and step line over a thin progress bar.
components.css: .ds-prog { font: 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #242424; } .ds-prog p { margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-prog progress { width: 100%; height: 5px; accent-color: #0f6cbd; }

narrative.overview: A neutral bench where generating, labeling and training sit side by side. The user chose an Azure AI Foundry / Fluent-style workspace: familiar Microsoft task and navigation patterns, white work surfaces on a pale gray bench, one blue for action. This is an operational tool for CSAs, approved video creators and customer AI engineers, not a marketing site. The interface recedes; the video, the frame under the cursor and the training numbers lead.
keyCharacteristics: Flat and bordered: depth comes from 1px lines, not shadows.
One accent, used only for actions and the current selection.
State is always spelled out in words, never by color alone, and never shown healthy unless verified.
Native inputs, details, selects and video controls; no decorative animation, remote fonts or marketing imagery.
The same shell serves two backends (Azure ML and local ComfyUI) and changes its wording, not its layout.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent is for actions and the current selection. Do not use it to decorate.

rules.name: The Words-First Rule
rules.body: A status color never carries meaning alone; the badge or notice names the state.

rules.name: The Plain Voice Rule
rules.body: No display type. Hierarchy comes from weight and spacing in one family.

dos: Do name every state in words: "Not configured" is not "offline"; "Unreachable" is not "failed".
Do keep generation, startup and spend approvals visibly separate.
Do show the total job count before submitting a batch.
Do keep errors visible until the user dismisses or resolves them; never retry a submission automatically.
Do surface licences (code and weights) beside every trainer, and provenance on every dataset.
Do stay within the Foundry/Fluent grammar: native controls, 1px lines, one accent.
donts: Don't show an unverified service as healthy, or invent sample videos, metrics or results; empty states explain the next step.
Don't use shadows, gradients, decorative motion, remote fonts or marketing imagery.
Don't let color alone carry status.
Don't use inline styles or inline scripts: the Content-Security-Policy forbids them, so visual variants are classes.
Don't present synthetic-only validation as real-world accuracy.
